note: Provider registry from the Flavor Intelligence research (sources.md, 2026-09-27). Only atlas_curated data is in the seed; atlas_learned is computed at runtime from the venue's own recipes. The other rows are the reviewed registry: allowed-but-unused sources (use / use_with_attribution) and sources that must not be ingested or need legal review. No data from any external source is ingested. Not legal advice; some licences were determined from search results where the primary page was blocked.

sources.name: Atlas curated culinary knowledge
sources.notes: Canonical ingredients, aroma/taste vectors, preparations and culinary pairing edges hand-authored by Atlas from general culinary and bartending knowledge. Not derived from any external dataset. Draft, needs human review (seed 0.1.0).

sources.name: VÁ BAR recipes in Atlas (co-occurrence)
sources.notes: atlas_learned evidence: ingredient co-occurrence in the venue's own recipes, computed at request time by the atlas-ai Edge Function. Tenant-scoped; never shared across tenants without consent.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.notes: Allowed for cross-reference ids and Icelandic/English labels; never flavour evidence. No data ingested in the MVP seed.

sources.name: FoodOn ontology
sources.attribution: Required: credit FoodOn and include the licence
sources.notes: Allowed for an optional foodon_id crosswalk and process terms. No data ingested in the MVP seed.

sources.name: PubChem (NCBI)
sources.license: Public domain for NCBI core data; depositor annotations carry their own terms
sources.notes: Core compound ids only, for a future scientific layer; depositor annotations need legal review. No data ingested in the MVP seed.

sources.name: USDA FoodData Central
sources.notes: Allowed for nutrition enrichment only (no flavour data). No data ingested in the MVP seed.

sources.name: Open Food Facts
sources.notes: Share-alike for public derivative databases; would need a separate bounded table. Not used in the MVP.

sources.name: TheCocktailDB
sources.license: Proprietary API (paid key for commercial use)
sources.notes: Storing their data as Atlas evidence is not granted; not used in the MVP.

sources.name: Ahn et al. 2011, Flavor network and the principles of food pairing
sources.notes: Non-commercial share-alike; recipe portion scraped from third-party sites. Finding may be cited as background only.

sources.name: Published culinary reference books (e.g. The Flavor Bible, The Flavour Thesaurus)
sources.notes: Their lists are not transcribed; overlap with common culinary facts is expected.

sources.name: CulinaryDB (CoSyLab)
sources.notes: Built from scraped sites; licence unknown.

sources.name: FlavorDB / FlavorDB2 (IIIT-Delhi CoSyLab)
sources.notes: Non-commercial. No molecule or pairing data from it is in Atlas.

sources.name: Flavornet (Acree & Arn, Cornell)
sources.notes: May be cited as literature only.

sources.name: FooDB
sources.notes: Non-commercial licence.

sources.name: Foodpairing
sources.notes: Do not ingest, scrape, reconstruct or imitate its data, graphs or visuals.

sources.name: The Good Scents Company
sources.notes: Staff may consult it; nothing is copied.

sources.name: Kaggle cocktail datasets
sources.license: Varies; often unknown or CC BY-NC
sources.notes: Often re-uploads of TheCocktailDB or publisher content. Classic ratios are authored by Atlas instead.

sources.name: LanguaL
sources.notes: Until written terms are obtained.

sources.name: Recipe1M / Recipe1M+ (MIT CSAIL)
sources.notes: Non-commercial terms of use.

sources.name: RecipeDB (CoSyLab)
sources.notes: Non-commercial.

sources.name: RecipeNLG and Kaggle recipe dumps
sources.notes: Unclear licences.
